title: Kennel Cough in Dogs: Symptoms, How Long It Lasts and Treatment
seoTitle: Kennel Cough in Dogs: Symptoms, Treatment, Vaccine
description: Kennel cough in dogs: the honking cough, how long it lasts and stays contagious, home care, warning signs of pneumonia and why Frenchies need extra care.
secondaryKeywords: how long does kennel cough last
is kennel cough contagious to humans

faq.q: How long does kennel cough last?
faq.a: Mild cases usually clear in 7 to 10 days, and the whole illness typically runs 10 to 20 days. A cough that lasts longer or gets worse needs a vet recheck.

faq.q: Is kennel cough contagious to humans?
faq.a: Rarely. Bordetella bronchiseptica has infrequently caused illness in people, typically those with weakened immune systems, and it can also affect cats. It spreads very easily between dogs.

faq.q: How long is a dog contagious with kennel cough?
faq.a: Cornell notes dogs can stay contagious for up to 8 weeks, possibly longer, after the cough stops. Keep your dog away from daycare, dog parks and groomers while coughing and for a while after.

faq.q: Can a vaccinated dog get kennel cough?
faq.a: Yes. The Bordetella vaccine doesn't always prevent infection, but vaccinated dogs usually have milder illness and a lower risk of pneumonia.

faq.q: When should I worry about kennel cough?
faq.a: See a vet the same day for fever, lethargy, loss of appetite, a wet cough or thick nasal discharge, which can signal pneumonia. Labored breathing is an emergency, especially in short-nosed breeds like French Bulldogs.
